title: Operational Risk / Enterprise Risk Management Framework (ERMF) Specialist
description: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world. About the Role We are seeking an experienced Operational Risk / ERMF Specialist to support the development, implementation, and continuous enhancement of the firm's Enterprise Risk Management Framework (ERMF). This role will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders across regional and global teams to strengthen risk governance, perform risk assessments, monitor key risk indicators (KRIs), and support operational risk initiatives across the organization.The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, analytical, and thrives in a fast-paced financial services or digital assets environment.
